question: What is the total quantity sold?
sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM fact_sales

question: How many products are in each category?
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM dim_product GROUP BY category ORDER BY product_count DESC

question: How many customers live in Sfax?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM dim_customer WHERE city = 'Sfax'

question: Which brands do we sell?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT brand FROM dim_product ORDER BY brand

question: What was the revenue per month in 2025?
sql: SELECT d.month, d.month_name, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.month, d.month_name ORDER BY d.month

question: How many units were sold by each store in 2024?
sql: SELECT s.store_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE d.year = 2024 GROUP BY s.store_key, s.store_name ORDER BY units DESC

question: What is the margin by product category?
sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue) - SUM(f.cost), 2) AS margin FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY margin DESC

question: Which brand has the highest revenue?
sql: SELECT p.brand, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the revenue by day of the week?
sql: SELECT d.day_of_week, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key GROUP BY d.day_of_week ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: What is the average revenue per sales line for B2C customers?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(f.revenue), 2) AS avg_line_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key WHERE c.segment = 'B2C'

question: What is the average discount given to B2B customers?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(f.discount_pct), 4) AS avg_discount FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key WHERE c.segment = 'B2B'

question: Which 3 cities have the most customers?
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM dim_customer GROUP BY city ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What was the margin of the Center region in 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.revenue) - SUM(f.cost), 2) AS margin FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE s.region = 'Center' AND d.year = 2025

question: How much revenue did the Baby care category make in the first quarter of 2024?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE p.category = 'Baby care' AND d.year = 2024 AND d.quarter = 1

question: Which product has the lowest margin rate?
sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND((SUM(f.revenue) - SUM(f.cost)) / SUM(f.revenue), 4) AS margin_rate FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key GROUP BY p.product_key, p.product_name ORDER BY margin_rate ASC LIMIT 1

question: What is the margin rate by region?
sql: SELECT s.region, ROUND((SUM(f.revenue) - SUM(f.cost)) / SUM(f.revenue), 4) AS margin_rate FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY margin_rate DESC

question: Compare the revenue of each category in 2024 and 2025.
sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2024 THEN f.revenue END), 2) AS revenue_2024, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2025 THEN f.revenue END), 2) AS revenue_2025 FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue_2025 DESC

question: What is the growth in units sold of Omega 3 between 2024 and 2025, in percent?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2025 THEN f.quantity END) - SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2024 THEN f.quantity END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2024 THEN f.quantity END), 2) AS growth_pct FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE p.product_name = 'Omega 3'

question: Who are the 5 B2C customers who spent the most in 2024?
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE c.segment = 'B2C' AND d.year = 2024 GROUP BY c.customer_key, c.customer_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which quarter of 2024 had the lowest revenue?
sql: SELECT d.quarter, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE d.year = 2024 GROUP BY d.quarter ORDER BY revenue ASC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers made at least one purchase in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_key) AS active_customers FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE d.year = 2025

question: Which customers made no purchase in the first quarter of 2025?
sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM dim_customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.customer_key = c.customer_key AND d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter = 1) ORDER BY c.customer_name

question: What is the average number of sales lines per day in 2025?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(line_count), 2) AS avg_lines_per_day FROM (SELECT d.date_key, COUNT(f.sale_id) AS line_count FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN fact_sales f ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.date_key)

question: Rank the stores by revenue in 2025.
sql: SELECT s.store_name, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue), 2) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(f.revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY s.store_key, s.store_name ORDER BY revenue_rank

question: What is the cumulative revenue month by month in 2024?
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT d.month, SUM(f.revenue) AS revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE d.year = 2024 GROUP BY d.month) SELECT month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_revenue FROM m ORDER BY month

question: What share of revenue does each category represent, in percent?
sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(f.revenue) / (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM fact_sales), 2) AS revenue_share_pct FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue_share_pct DESC

question: For each store, which product sold the most units?
sql: WITH u AS (SELECT f.store_key, f.product_key, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.store_key ORDER BY SUM(f.quantity) DESC) AS rn FROM fact_sales f GROUP BY f.store_key, f.product_key) SELECT s.store_name, p.product_name, u.units FROM u JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = u.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = u.product_key WHERE u.rn = 1 ORDER BY s.store_name

question: Combien de clients B2C avons-nous ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_clients FROM dim_customer WHERE segment = 'B2C'

question: Quelle est la marge totale en 2025 ?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.revenue) - SUM(f.cost), 2) AS marge FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE d.year = 2025

question: Quels sont les 3 produits les plus vendus en quantité dans la catégorie Hair care ?
sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS quantite FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key WHERE p.category = 'Hair care' GROUP BY p.product_key, p.product_name ORDER BY quantite DESC LIMIT 3

question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires du magasin Lac 2 par trimestre en 2025 ?
sql: SELECT d.quarter, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue), 2) AS chiffre_affaires FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE s.store_name = 'Lac 2' AND d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.quarter ORDER BY d.quarter

question: Quel est le taux de marge des clients B2B ?
sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(f.revenue) - SUM(f.cost)) / SUM(f.revenue), 4) AS taux_marge FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key WHERE c.segment = 'B2B'
